meta.title: Sheet Practice: spreadsheet cleanup and workflow prototypes
meta.description: Independent spreadsheet consulting. Cleanup for untidy data, or a small working prototype for a repeated task, then a discussion before anything is built.

rationale: Страница построена как выбор и чтение: сначала hero.action-desk помогает понять, какая услуга подходит (грязные данные или повторяющаяся задача), затем идут два разворота услуг и три шага процесса. Холодный светлый фон, графитовый текст и один зелёный акцент вместе с Space Grotesk и IBM Plex Sans дают точный технический характер. VisualPlan: единственная иллюстрация, абстрактная схема из трёх панелей (образец, пример, решение), показывает связь шагов и не выдаёт себя за скриншот реального инструмента; фото, логотипа, контактов и формы нет.

props.headline: Spreadsheet help for two situations
props.sub: Independent spreadsheet consulting. Choose cleanup when the data you have is untidy, or a workflow prototype when the same task keeps coming round.

actions.title: The data is untidy
actions.detail: Names and dates are written several ways, and some rows may be duplicates.

actions.title: A task keeps coming round
actions.detail: You repeat the same steps and want to see a small working version first.

actions.title: I want to see how it runs
actions.detail: Three steps, from a sample to a decision.

props.title: Two services
props.intro: Cleanup is for data you already have. A prototype is for a task you keep repeating.

items.name: Spreadsheet cleanup
items.description: Names and dates made consistent across the sheet, and duplicate rows identified so you can see them and decide what to do with them.

items.name: Workflow prototypes
items.description: A small working example for one repeated task, so you can see it run. We then talk it through before anything is implemented.

steps.name: Discuss a sample
steps.detail: We look at a small sample of your sheet and the task that keeps repeating.

steps.name: Review an example
steps.detail: You get a small working example for that task and look at how it behaves.

steps.name: Decide what to implement
steps.detail: We talk it through, and you choose what gets built before any implementation starts.
